$description: Device Benchmark v1 design tokens (W3C DTCG). Dark-only. Every colour pair states its MEASURED WCAG contrast ratio, computed rather than eyeballed. No token combination defined here falls below its requirement, so producing a contrast failure requires inventing a colour outside this file. Direction: 'instrument readout, not a dashboard'. From Gate 2, 2026-08-23.

base.$description: Page ground. Cold graphite with a blue-green cast, deliberately NOT neutral near-black - that plus one acid accent is a named AI-default cluster.

raised.$description: Panels: sub-score table, notice panel, consent block.

sunken.$description: The axis well and the live trace field only.

primary.$description: Warm bone against a cold ground. 15.18:1 on bg.base, 14.08:1 on bg.raised.

muted.$description: FLOOR. 5.54:1 on bg.base, 5.14:1 on bg.raised. No greyer text token exists, so grey-on-grey is impossible by construction. Lightened from #7C868D after computing 4.52:1 - too tight.

on-accent.$description: Label on a bone-filled primary button. 15.18:1.

live.$description: USED ONLY WHILE MEASURING. 6.97:1 on bg.base, 7.29:1 on bg.sunken. Never appears on the result screen - the resting product is essentially colourless.

trace-dim.$description: Elapsed portion of the live trace. 3.85:1 on bg.sunken, meets the 3:1 non-text requirement.

structural.$description: Axis, ticks, control borders, table rules. 3.61:1 on bg.base, 3.35:1 on bg.raised, 3.78:1 on bg.sunken - all meet WCAG 1.4.11. Lightened from #5E6970 after computing 3.05:1 - too tight.

decorative.$description: 1.4:1. Panel edges ONLY. Never a control boundary, never state indication. Exempt as pure decoration.

ok.$description: 'Held steady', 'Recovered'. 7.54:1 on bg.raised. Never used without accompanying text (WCAG 1.4.1).

notice.$description: ACHROMATIC BY DECISION. Confidence notes and the unscored-run panel. 10.80:1 on bg.raised. Amber is BANNED here: an amber badge beside a sustained-load figure would read as thermal, and the page never claims a temperature.

fault.$description: The ONLY red in the app. Integrity-check failure or crash. 6.02:1 on bg.base, 5.58:1 on bg.raised. NEVER used on the sustained figure - a device that slowed 40% is not an error.

ring.$description: Always drawn OUTSIDE the component via outline-offset 2px, so the only pair that ever matters is ring against page background: 15.18:1. This rule makes a failing focus ring impossible.

primary.$description: Variable weight + width, OFL, self-hosted subset WOFF2. The width axis is the third hierarchy device, which is why one family suffices. NOT Inter/Roboto/system-ui/Space Grotesk.

data.$description: Identity stamp, raw values, units, JSON preview. Fallback if 360px overflow: Spline Sans Mono. NOT JetBrains Mono. MUST be self-hosted: a Google Fonts request would be a THIRD-PARTY ORIGIN, which the privacy rules forbid outright, and font-src 'self' blocks it regardless.

score.$description: 72px floor at 360px, 144px ceiling from 800px up. MUST render 1 to 4 digits without overflow - test with 9999 at 320px effective width (1280px at 400% zoom, WCAG 1.4.10).

xs.$description: SMALLEST PERMITTED. The identity stamp. Never below 12px.

score.$description: Container MUST be sized by content flow, never a fixed height: WCAG 1.4.12 forces 1.5 and the box must grow rather than clip.

12.$description: Idle-screen breathing room. Start with too much.

panel.$description: Machined, not rounded. CEILING for the whole app is 4px.

pill.$description: Segmented control ends. Nothing exceeds this.

min.$description: Design minimum for every interactive element. WCAG 2.5.8 floor is 24px; this exceeds it deliberately.

gap.$description: Minimum clear space between adjacent targets. Cancel gets 24px.

instant.$description: Value under prefers-reduced-motion. EVERY duration token resolves here. ⚠️ See UX-01: the GPU preview is NOT covered by this, because removing it would remove work from inside the measured window.

trace.$description: Live trace redraw interval under reduced motion. Full cadence otherwise.
